m: निर्—आभास mfn. without fallacious appearance, HaṃsUp.
निर्-आ-√ धा -दधाति, to take out of, take away, AV.; Br.
निर्—आधान (निर्-), mfn. unbridled, TBr. (cf. अन्तर्-आध्˚).
निर्—आधार mfn. without a receptacle or a support, MBh.
निर्—आधार—त्व n., Sarvad.
निर्—आधि mfn. free from anxiety, secure, Kām.
निर्-आ-णद्ध mfn. (√ नह्), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 2, Kāś.
निर्—आशा f. hopelessness, despair, Subh.; Hcar.
निर्—आ˚शासन्न mfn. nearly driven to despair, Hcar.
निर्—आ˚शी-भाव m. despair, L.
निर्—आ˚शी-भूत mfn. become hopeless, despairing, MW.
निर्—आशीस्-त्व n., MBh. xii, 12440

s: nirASaH
tri, (nirgatA ASA yasmAditi .) ASASUnyaH । yaTA, tiTitattve । “BUtAhe ye prakurvvanti ulkAgrahamacetasaH । nirASAH pitaro yAnti SApaM dattvA sudAruRam ॥”
v: nirASa

tri॰ nirgatA ASA yasya prA॰ ba॰ । ASArahite “nirASAH pitaro yAnti SApaM dattvA sudAruRam” ti॰ ta॰ “sano baBUvendumatInirASam” raGuH । tasya BAvaH pyaY । nErASya ASASUnyatve “ASA balavatI rAjan! nErASyaM paramaM suKam । ASAM nirASAM kftvA tu suKaM svapiti piNgalA” BA॰ SA॰ 178 a॰ ।
m: निर्—आश mf(आ)n. without any hope or wish or desire, indifferent, Kap.; Kāv.; Rājat. &c. (आशाम् निर्-आशां √ कृ, to make hope hopeless i.e. giving up all hope, MBh. xii, 6647; cf. 6520)
despairing or despondent of (with loc. dat. acc. and प्रति abl., or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
निर्—आशङ्क mf(आ)n. fearless, being not afraid of (loc. for infin.), Cāṇ.
निर्—आशङ्कम् ind. without fear or hesitation, Śaṃk.
निर्—आशङ्˚क्य mfn. not to be apprehended, Daś.
निर्—आश—गुटिका f. w.r. for ˚स-ग्˚ (see under 2. निर्-आस, p. 553)
निर्—आश—क mfn. despairing of (abl.), MBh. viii, 3761
निर्—आश—कर mfn. taking away all hope, making impossible (in comp.), Gīt. xii, 20
निर्—आश—ता, f. (Bhām.), निर्—आश—त्व, n. (Pañc. B.) hopelessness, despair
निर्—आशय mfn. (wound) not deep, Suśr. (v.l. for -आश्रय).
निर्—आ˚शिन् mfn. hopeless, despairing, MBh. (˚शि-त्व n. hopelessness, Kām.; v.l. for ˚श-त्व, Pañc.)
निर्—आशिस् mfn. hopeless, despairing, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (˚शीस्-त्व n., MBh. xii, 12440)
free from desire, indifferent,Kum. v, 76
without a blessing, W.
निर्—आ˚शि-त्व n., hopelessness, Kām.; v.l. for ˚श-त्व, Pañc.

v: nirASiz
tri॰ nirgatA ASI rASaMsanaM yasya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 ASaMsanaSUnye “jagacCaraRyasya nirASizaH sataH” kumA॰ “nirASIrnimamo BUtvA yuDyasva vigatajvara” gItA । vErAgyadArQyena 2 vigatatfzRe ca ।

m: निर्—आश्रम mfn. not being in one of the four periods or stages of a Brāhman's life, Kull. (˚मिन् id., ib.)
निर्—आश्रम—पद mfn. (a wood) having no hermitages in it, Kathās.

v: nirASraya

tri॰ nirgata ASraya ADAro'valambanaM vA yasya । 1 ASrayarahite 2 Alambanarahite ca “citraM yaTASrayamfte sTARvAdiByo vinA yaTA CAyA । tadvadvinA viSe zErna tizWati nirASrayaM liNgam” sAM॰ kA॰ “nirASrayaM mAM jagadISa! rakza” udBawaH “tyaktvA karmaPalAsaNgaM nityavfpto nirASrayaH” gItA “nirASrayaH yogakzemArTamASrayaRIyarahitaH” SrIDaraH । 3 advEtadarSanena dehendriyAdyaBimAnaSUnye SabdArTaci॰ ।
m: निर्—आश्रय mfn. shelterless, R.
supportless, having or offering no prop or stay, destitute, alone, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
not deep (v.l. ˚शय), lying open, Suśr.

s: nirAbADaH

tri, (nirgatA AbADA pratibanDo yasmAt .) pakzABAsaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “aprasidDaM nirAbADaM nirarTaM nizprayojanam । asADyaM vA virudDaM vA pakzABAsaM vivarjjayet ॥ nirAvADaM asmadgfhapradIpaprakASenAyaM svagfhe vyavaharati .” iti mitAkzarA ॥
v: nirAbADa

tri॰ nirgatA AbADA yasya । 1 AbADASUnye 2 vyaTASUnye 3 prativanDaSUnye ca “davIyAn mahIDaro nedIyAn dIrGo bahuriti vyavahAraSca nirAbADaM jAgarUkatvatvAt” sarvadarSanasaM॰ । 4 pakzABAsaBede pu॰ “aprasidDaM nirAbADaM nirarTaM nizprayojanam । asADyaM vA virudDaM vA pakzABAsaM vivarjayet” mitA॰ Dftavacanam । “nirAbADam asmadgfhapradIpaprakASenAyaM svagfhe vyavaha ratIti” mitAkzarA ।
m: निर्—आबाध mf(आ)n. undisturbed unmolested, secure, MBh.; Hariv.
निर्—आबाध—कर mfn. not causing injury or pain, Hariv.
निर्—आबाधम् ind. (incontestably, Sarvad.) not disturbing, not molesting, harmless, guileless, ib.
frivolously or unreally vexatious (as a cause of complaint), Yājñ., Sch.

s: nirAcAraH
tri, nirna vidyate AcAro yasya saH । anAcAraH । AcAraSUnyaH ॥
m: निर्—आचार mfn. without approved usages or customs, lawless, barbarian, Hcat.
निर्-आ-√ चक्ष् Ā. -चष्टे, to refute, reject, Sarvad.
निर्-आ-चिकीर्षु (Desid. of √ 1. कृ), desirous of contradicting or refuting, Śaṃk.
निर्—आदान mfn. taking or receiving nothing, MBh.
निर्—आदान m. N. of Buddha, L.
निर्—आदर mfn. showing no respect, disrespectful, Rājat.
निर्-आ-देश m. complete payment or discharge of a debt, W.
a: निरादेशः — Complete payment of a debt.

m: निर्-आ-दिष्ट mfn. (√ दिश्) paid off (as a debt), Mn. viii, 162.
a: निरादिष्ट — a. Paid off as a debt.

m: निर्—आगार mfn. houseless, shelterless,
नि-राग mfn. passionless, dispassionate, ŚāṅkhBr. (cf. नी-र्˚).
निर्—आगम mfn. not founded on revelation, MBh.
निर्-आगम निर्-आगस्, &c. See p. 540, col. 1.
निर्—आगस् mfn. sinless, innocent, Ragh.; Rājat.
निर्—आग्रह mfn. not insisting upon, not obstinate, Rājat.

s: nirAhAraH
tri, (nirgata AhAro yasya .) AhArarahitaH । yaTA, -- “nirAhArASca ye jIvAH pApe Darmme ratASca ye .” iti tarpaRaprakaraRIyAhnikAcAraDftavacanam ॥
v: nirAhAra

tri॰ nirgata AhAro yasya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 AhAraSUnye “nirAhArASca ye jIvAH” tarpaRamantraH । nivftta AhAraH prA॰ sa॰ । 2 nivftte AhAre “paScAttApo nirAdvAraH sarve'mI SudDihetavaH” yAjYa॰ avyayI॰ । 3 AhArABAve na॰
m: निर्—आहार m. want of food, fasting, Yājñ.
निर्—आहार mf(आ)n. having no food or abstaining from it, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
निर्—आहार—ता f. foodlessness, fasting, MBh.; Kathās.
निर्-आह m. (prob. fr. next) call, exclamation, TāṇḍBr.
निर्-आहव m. (√ ह्वे) id.
निर्-आहव—वत् mfn. accompanied by an exclamation, ib. (v.l. ˚हा-वत्).
निर्—आजीव्य mf(आ)n. not yielding subsistence, Kām.
निर्-आज m. marching off, Kāṭh.
निर्-आज See under निर्-अज्.

v: nirAkANkza

tri॰ nirgatA AkANkzA apekzA icCA vA yasya prA॰ va॰ । 1 SAbdaboDopayogyapekzASUnye 2 icCASUnye ca “tezAM vAkyaM nirAkANkzam” kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 1 । 3 । 2 “yAvat padavfndaM nirAkANkzaM pUrvAparapaWitapadAntarAkANkzArahitam” saMgrahavyAKyA । AkANkzAsvarUpaYca AkANkzASabde dfSyam ।
m: निर्—आकाङ्क्ष mfn. expecting or wishing nothing, desireless, hopeless, Kathās.; Pur. (also ˚क्षिङ्, MBh.)
wanting nothing to fill up, complete (वाक्य), KātyŚr.; Sāh.
निर्—आकाश mfn. having no free space, completely filled, R.

s: nirAkAraH

puM, (nirgata AkAro dehAdidfSyasvarUpaM yasmAditi । nirAdaya iti samAsaH .) parameSvaraH । brahma । yaTA, -- “sAkAraYca nirAkaraM saguRaM nirguRaM praBum । sarvvADAraYca sarvvaYca svecCArUpaM namAmyaham ॥” api ca । “tejaHsvarUpo BagavAn nirAkAro nirASrayaH । nilipto nirguRaH sAkzI svAtmArAmaH parAtparaH ॥ DyAyanti yoginastejastvadIyamaSarIriRam । vEzRavAScEva sAkAraM kamanIyaM manoharam ॥ keciccaturBujaM SAntaM lakzmIkAntaM manoharam । SaptracakragadApadmaDaraM pItAmbaraM param ॥ dviBujaM kamanIyaYca kiSoraM SyAmasundaram । SAntaM gopANganAkAntaM ratnaBUyaRaBUzitam ॥ ezaM tejasvinaM BaktyA sevante satataM mudA । DyAyanti yogino yattu kutastejasvinaM vinA ॥” api ca । “yonirguRaH sa nirliptaH SaktiByo nahi saMyutaH । sisfkzurASritaH SaktO nirguRaH saguRo Bavet ॥ yAvanti ca SarIrARi BogArhARi mahAmune ! । prAkftAni ca sarvvARi SrIkfzRavigrahaM vinA ॥ DyAyanti yoginastaYca SudDaM jyotiHsvarUpiRam । hastapAdAdirahitaM nirguRaM prakfteH param ॥ vEzRavAstaM na manyante tadBaktAH sUkzmadarSinaH । kuto baBUva tajjyotiraho tejasvinaM vinA ॥ jyotiraByantare nityaM SarIraM SyAmasundaram । atIvAmUlyasadratnaBUzaRena viBUzitam ॥ evaM BaktASca DyAyanti SaSvaccaraRasevinaH । yogino yogarUpaYca kAle BaktibipAkataH ॥ jyotiraByantare mUrttiM paSyanti kfpayA praBoH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte gaRapatiKaRqe । 32 । 7 । 42 aH ॥ tasya dbicatvAriMSannAmAni yaTA, -- “jagadyonirayonistvamananto'vyaya eva ca । jyotiHsvarUpo hyanaGaH saguRo nirguRo mahAn ॥ BaktAnuroDAt sAkAro nirAkAro niraNkuSaH । nirvyUho niKilADAro niHSaNko nirupadravaH ॥ nirupADiSca nirlipto nirIho niDanAntakaH । svAtmArAmaH pUrRakAmo'nimezo nitya eva ca ॥ suBago durBago vAgmI durArADyo duratyayaH । vedahetuSca vedASca vedANgo vedavidbiBuH ॥ dvicatvAriMSannAmAni prAtarutTAya yaH paWet । dfQAM BaktiM harerdAsye laBate vAYCitaYca yat ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 7 aDyAyaH ॥ AkAraSUnye, tri ॥
v: nirAkAra

tri॰ nirgataH AkAro'vayavo'sya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 avayavahIne 2 dehAdyAkAravarjite brahmaRi ca “tejaHsvarUpo BagavAn nirAkAro nirASrayaH” brahmavE॰ janmasya॰ 7 a॰ । “nirAkarajYAnavAde'pi yogyatAvaSena pratikarmavyavasTAyAH sTitatvAt” sarvada॰ । AkAra AhvAnam । 3 nirgatAhvAne ca “nirAkArA nirAnandA dInA pratihatasvanA” (ayoDyA) rAmA॰ ayo॰ 113 sa॰ ।
m: 1. निर्—आकार mfn. formless, shapeless, incorporeal (ब्रह्मन्), making no appearance or show, insignificant, unimportant, MBh.; R. &c.
having no object (cf. below)
निर्—आकार m. N. of Śiva, Śivag.
of Viṣṇu, L.
heaven, L.
the universal spirit, god, L.
2. निर्-आ-˚कार (for 1. See p. 540, col. 1) m. rebuke, reproach, censure, L.
a: निराकारः — Reproach, censure; see under निर् also

m: 1. निर्—आकार—ज्ञान-वाद m. the doctrine that the perception of the outer world does not arise from images impressed on the mind, Sarvad.
1. निर्—आकार—लोचन n. a vacant (lit. objectless) look, Mṛcch., Sch.

v: nirAka
pu॰ nira + aka--vakragatO BAve GaY । 1 pAke 2 svede ca karmaRi GaY । asatkarmaPale hemaca॰ ।
m: निराक m. (only L., prob. w.r. for नि-पाक) cooking
sweat
the recompence of a bad action.
a: निराकः — 1 Cooking. --2 Sweat. --3 The recompense of a bad action (v. l. for निपाक).

m: निर्-आ-˚करणीय mfn. to be opposed or refuted, Śaṃk.

s: nirAkaraRaM
klI, (nir + A + kf + lyuw .) nivAraRam । nirasanam । iti nirAkarizRuSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: निर्-आ-˚करण n. separating (in अ-निराक्˚), Sarvad.
driving away, turning out, expelling, removing, repudiating (of a woman), opposing, contradicting, denying, Kālid.; Sarvad. &c.
forgetting (in अ-निराक्˚), TĀr.; PārGṛ.
neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties, W.
a: निराकरणं — 1 Repudiating, expelling, turning away; निराकरणविक्लवा Ś. 6. --2 Banishing. --3 Obstruction, contradiction, opposition, rejection. --4 Refutation, reply. --5 Contempt. --6 Neglecting the chief sacrificial duties. --7 Forgetting.

s: nirAkarizRuH

tri, (nirAkaroti tacCIlaH । nira + A + kf + “alaMkfYnirAkfYiti .” 3 । 2 । 136 । iti izRuc .) nirAkaraRaSIlaH । tatparyyAyaH । kzipnuH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 30 ॥ (yaTA, BawwikAvye । 5 । 1 । “nirAkarizRurvarttizRurvardDizRuH parito raRam ॥”)
v: nirAkarizRu

tri॰ nir + A + kf--SIlArTe izRuc । nirAkaraRaSIle nivAraRaSIle “nirAkarizRU varttizRU vardDizRU parito raRam” BawwiH “nirAkarizRorvfjinAdfte'pi” raGuH “nirAkarizRutA cEva vijYeyAH pASavAguRAH” suSrutaH ।
m: निर्-आ-˚करिष्णु mfn. rejecting, repudiating, Ragh.
obstructive, envious, hindering or preventing from (abl.), Rājat.
forgetful, PārGṛ.
a: निराकरिष्णु — a. 1 Repudiating, turning out, expelling; R. 14. 57. --2 Hindering from, obstructive. --3 Spurning, disdaining. --4 Seeking to deprive one of a thing. --5 Forgetful.

k.v: निराकरिष्णुः क्षिप्नुः स्यात्सान्द्रस्निग्धस्तु मेदुरः। ज्ञाता तु विदुरो विन्दुर्विकासी तु विकस्वरः॥

m: निर्-आ-˚करिष्णु—ता f. envy, malevolence, Suśr.
निर्-आ-˚कर्तव्य mfn. = ˚करणीय, Śaṃk.
निर्-आ-˚कर्तृ mfn. contradicting, refuting, Śaṃk.
repudiating, repudiator of (gen.), Hcat.
contemner, despiser (esp. of the Veda and religion), MBh.
निर्-आ-√ 1. कृ P. -करोति, to separate or divide off, ChUp.; to drive away, turn or keep off, repudiate, remove, reject, omit, refuse, spurn, oppose, contradict, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: निराकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To expel, drive away, repudiate; Bk. 6. 100; R. 14. 57. --2 To refute (as an opinion). --3 To give up, abandon. --4 To destroy completely, annihilate. --5 To revile, contemn, slight. --6 To oppose, obstruct, contradict. --7 To refuse, decline, reject. --8 To omit. --9 To disappoint, frustrate.

m: निर्-आ-˚कृ˚तान्योत्तर mfn. excluding every answer, irrefutable (-त्व n.), L.
निर्-आ-˚कृ˚तान्योत्तर—त्व n.

s: nirAkftaH
tri, (nir + A + kf + ktaH .) pratyAKyAtaH । nirastaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 40 ॥
m: निर्-आ-˚कृत mfn. pushed or driven away, repudiated, expelled, banished, rejected, removed
frustrated, destroyed
omitted, forgot
refuted
despised, made light of MBh.; Kāv. &c.
deprived of (comp.), Bhaṭṭ.
a: निराकृत — p. p. 1 Expelled, banished. --2 Refuted. --3 Despised, &c. see निराकृ above. --Comp. --अन्योत्तर a. irrefutable, unanswerable.

k.v: आत्तगर्वोऽभिभूतः स्याद्दापितः साधितः समौ। प्रत्यादिष्टो निरस्तः स्यात्प्रत्याख्यातो निराकृतः॥

m: निर्-आ-˚कृत—निमेष mfn. (eye) forgetting to wink, Śak. (Pi.) ii, 11 (41)

s: nirAkftiH

strI, (nir + A + kf + ktin .) nirasanam । nirAkaraRam । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 31 ॥ (nirgatA AkftiryasmAditi .) anAkAre asvADyAye ca tri । iti medinI । te, 203 ॥ (puM, paYcamahAyajYAnuzWAnarahitaH । yaTA, manuH । 3 । 154 । “yakzmI ca paSupAlaSca parivettA nirAkftiH ॥” “nirAkftiH paYcamahAyajYAnuzWAnarahitaH । taTA ca CandogapariSizwam । nirAkarttAmarAdInAM sa vijYeyo nirAkftiH ॥” iti kullUkaBawwaH ॥ “nirAkftiH satyaDikAre mahAyajYAnuzWAnarahitaH । anadDA nirAkftirucyate । evaM hi SatapaTe । yo na devAnarccati na pitFn na manuzyAniti । yEstu paWyate asvADyAyaSrutaDanErnirAkftirudAhftaH .” iti meDAtiTiH ॥ * ॥ rohitamanuputtraH । yaTA, harivaMSe । 7 । 63 । “dakzaputtrasya puttrAste rohitasya prajApateH । manoH puttro DfzwaketuH paYcahotro nirAkftiH ॥”)
v: nirAkfti

strI nir + A + kf--ktin । 1 pratyAdeSe nirAkaraRe nivAraRe amaraH । “pralayaH suKaduHKAByAM cezwAjYAnanirAkftiH” sA॰ da॰ । nirgatA AkftirAkAro'sya prA॰ ba॰ । 2 nirAkAre “yo'sO vizRuragADAtmA paramAtmA nirAkftiH” harivaM॰ 218 a॰ । nir + A + kf--karttari ktic । 3 paYcayajYatyAgini pu॰ “yakzmI ca paSuSAlaSca parivettA nirAkftiH” manuH “yastu paYca mahAyajYavihInaH sa nirAkftiH” kullU॰ Dftavacanam । “nirAkarttAsurAdInAM sa vijYeyo nirAkftiH” SabdArTaci॰ DftavAkyam । tasya devayajYanirAkarttftvAt taTAtvam । 4 rohitamanuputraBede pu॰ “dakzaputrasya putrAste rohitasya prajApateH । manoH putro DfzwaketuH paYcahotro nirAkftiH” harivaM॰ 7 a॰ ।
m: निर्—आकृति mfn. formless, shapeless (Viṣṇu), Hariv.
deformed, ugly, MārkP.
निर्—आकृति m. a person who neglects his religious duties, (esp.) a Brāhman who has not duly read the Vedas, Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. etc.
2. निर्-आ-˚कृति f. (for 1. See p. 540, col. 1), obstruction, impediment, interruption, Sāh.
repudiation, rejection, contradiction, refutation, L.
forgetting (see सर्व-न्˚), BhP.
निर्-आ-˚कृति mfn. impeding, obstructing, L.
निर्-आ-˚कृति m. N. of a son of the first Manu Sāvarṇi, Hariv.
a: निराकृतिः — f. निराक्रिया 1 Repudiation, expulsion, rejection. --2 Refusal. --3 Obstruction, obstacle, impediment, interruption. --4 Opposition.
